summary: iter-217 (v62.2 PAMM × Strategy Certification Campaigns) HTTP end-to-end verification. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter217_cert_campaign_http.py — 36 HTTP tests, ALL PASS in 8.4s. Coverage matches the review request exactly: (1) GET /certification with no campaign returns {campaign:null, lifecycle=[DRAFT..REVOKED], stages=[REPLAY,SHADOW,DEMO,CANARY], criteria for all four stages}. (2) POST /certification/start: 400 no_assignment before assign; after POST /strategy (sniper + controlled) → 200 DRAFT with campaign_id starting 'scc_' and 32-char identity.identity_hash; second start → 409 campaign_exists. (3) POST /certification/advance walks DRAFT→VALIDATING; second advance blocked 409 validation_required until /strategy/validate passes, then advances to REPLAY. (4) In REPLAY: evaluate with no evidence returns passed:false (missing evidence never passes); advance without passing eval → 409 stage_evaluation_required; checkpoint with empty metrics → 400 metrics_required; checkpoint with good REPLAY metrics {decisions_replayed:250, determinism_ok:true, expectancy_lower_r:0.05, risk_violations:0} → hash-chained evidence record (seq/hash/prev_hash); evaluate → passed:true; advance → SHADOW. (5) SHADOW: bad checkpoint {orders_placed:1} evaluate returns passed:false with no_orders_placed check failing; then good SHADOW metrics → passed:true; advance → DEMO. (6) DEMO good metrics → passed:true → CANARY. (7) CANARY good metrics → passed:true → CERTIFIED — cert_id returned, db.certifications doc created, GET /strategy shows assignment.certification_status='CERTIFIED' and cert_id stamped. (8) CERTIFIED→LIVE advance blocked 409 assignment_not_active; POST /strategy/activate (with step-up) makes assignment ACTIVE (certification_required does NOT block because program has no LIVE master account); advance → LIVE. (9) GET /certification/evidence: chain_valid:true, count≥12, every record carries hash+prev_hash+seq. (10) Revoke: mid-pipeline SHADOW campaign on program_mid → state DRAFT (abort transition); revoke CERTIFIED/LIVE campaign on program_main → state REVOKED, assignment.certification_status='REVOKED', cert doc revoked in db.certifications. (11) AUTH/BOLA: all 5 POST cert endpoints (start/checkpoint/evaluate/advance/revoke) return 403 for a non-admin pamm_manager user; advance/revoke return 403 with step_up_required (code) when X-Step-Up-Bypass is stripped; GET /certification returns 403 for a random non-member authenticated user. (12) REGRESSION: /api/pamm/strategies still lists 4 strategies; fresh-program full v62.1 lifecycle GET(LEGACY)→POST assign→validate→activate→suspend all succeed. Cleanup verified: 0 iter217 programs, 0 iter217 users, 0 open cert campaigns cluster-wide, and demo pgm_c270193fed still has 0 assignments/campaigns (LEGACY as found).
critical_code_review_comments: certification_campaign.evaluate_stage() is a PURE function with explicit per-stage criteria; every check surfaces {key, ok, actual, required} — excellent for auditability. Missing metrics correctly FAIL (_ge/_le/_gt short-circuit on None).

evidence chain: _append_evidence() computes hash from (record + prev_hash), stores seq monotonically, and verify_chain() walks the whole chain — GET /certification/evidence returned chain_valid:true after 12+ mutations. Solid tamper-evident design.

_advance_gate() is defence-in-depth: re-checks assignment linkage, version pin, stage evaluation passing (state must match), cert validity + assignment ACTIVE for CERTIFIED→LIVE. All paths exercised and correct.

The certification_required check inside strategy_assignment.activate() is correctly gated on the presence of a LIVE master account — a program without a broker account can be ACTIVATED without a CERTIFIED assignment. This is spec-correct but WORTH DOCUMENTING (the friendly comment in the code helps).

GET /certification/evidence returns 404 if no campaign — good; the review scoped 'GET certification status is program-access scoped', but 'evidence' endpoint ALSO enforces require_program_access before the 404, so BOLA is safe there too.

Suggestion (non-blocking): collect_auto_metrics merges auto+manual with manual winning (via {**auto, **manual}). Consider explicitly labelling which metrics came from auto vs checkpoint in the evaluate response so admin auditors can distinguish tamper-evident manual data from best-effort platform-observed data. Currently only sorted key lists are surfaced.
Suggestion (non-blocking): checkpoint payload accepts an arbitrary 'note' string but does not enforce a max length — a huge note could bloat the evidence chain. Consider truncating to e.g. 500 chars.

Suggestion (non-blocking): the revoke endpoint returns 409 only for 'cannot_revoke' — but revoking a DRAFT campaign hits this because DRAFT→DRAFT is not a valid transition. Returning a 400 with an explicit 'already_draft' would communicate the situation more clearly to admins.
test_credentials: admin@stoicaibot.com / admin123 (cookie auth + X-CSRF-Token). STEP_UP_BYPASS_TOKEN from backend/.env used to bypass step-up MFA for advance/revoke (server-side secret, refused when APP_ENV=production).

Per-class programs: program_main (full pipeline walk to LIVE, then REVOKED), program_mid (walked to SHADOW then revoked to DRAFT), program_bola (untouched, used for auth tests), plus 1 short-lived program in TestRegressionStrategyEndpoints. All programs prefixed 'TEST_iter217_*'. Users prefixed 'test_iter217_*'. context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter217_cert_campaign_http.py is the canonical HTTP regression for v62.2 PAMM × strategy certification campaigns. Key gotchas: (1) conftest.py auto-injects X-Step-Up-Bypass. To exercise the REAL step-up gate on advance/revoke, set session.headers['X-Step-Up-Bypass']='' before the call and restore after (see TestAuthAndStepUp._no_stepup helper). (2) TestFullPipeline is order-sensitive — tests are named test_01..test_24 and rely on state carrying between tests via the module-scoped program_main fixture. Do NOT reorder or parallelize (pytest-xdist would break it). (3) Cleanup in _cleanup_program() removes assignments, campaigns, evidence, AND revokes-linked cert docs from db.certifications. Extend _cleanup_program if new collections are introduced in v62.3+. (4) The mid-pipeline revoke test only works from evidence stages (REPLAY/SHADOW/DEMO/CANARY) — revoking a DRAFT campaign would hit 'cannot_revoke' because DRAFT→DRAFT is not an allowed transition. (5) evidence.count assertion is >=12 which held with the current flow (start=1 + validate=n/a + 4 checkpoints + 5 evaluations + 6 stage_advanced + 1 revoke = 17); if new events are added or removed adjust the floor. (6) The offline suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter217_cert_campaign.py (26 unit tests) is complementary and was not re-run here — main agent already reported it green.
